App details

Image Resizer & Compressor

Resize and compress photos on your device, with previews and batch processing.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Make photos smaller for sharing or adjust their dimensions for printing. Process several images together, preview the changes and choose whether to keep their metadata. All image processing happens on your device.

Main features

  • Choose dimensions, quality or target file size.
  • Keep proportions or crop to fit.
  • Preview changes and control image metadata.
  • Calculate print size from pixels and print resolution.

This app is being planned and is not yet available to download. The description presents its intended functions.

Features in detail

Image dimensions, file size and print planning

Resize by dimensions or percentage

Choose an image and enter width×height, only width or height, or a percentage, including 25/50/75% presets. Aspect-ratio lock starts on. Fit keeps proportions inside a frame, Fill/Crop fills it with cropping, and explicit Stretch can distort. Output is a new image; the original is not silently overwritten.

Print size and pixels per inch

Enter pixel dimensions and PPI, meaning image pixels per inch, to find print width/height in cm or inches. Or enter physical size plus PPI to find required whole pixel dimensions. Missing PPI must be supplied by you; changing a PPI label alone does not resize pixels. Printer DPI measures print dots, a different quantity.

Quality, file-size target and formats

Adjust JPEG or supported lossy WebP quality, or set a maximum file-size target such as 500 KB. Pixel reduction requires your permission; an unreachable target is reported. JPEG, PNG and WebP are planned, AVIF when the device can save it. PNG uses lossless handling; losing transparency prompts a warning.

Metadata choices and Privacy Clean

Choose to keep supported photo metadata or remove it. Privacy Clean removes unnecessary camera/device and location data, especially GPS tags. The visible image keeps its correct orientation even when rotation metadata is removed. Which photo fields can be retained depends on the image format.

Preview, comparison, batches and sharing

Compare original and new pixel/file dimensions and absolute/percentage savings. Final bytes are known only after saving. Process several images with one profile, follow each result, and cancel before further items start. Safe names avoid collisions. Save to your chosen place or share successful outputs; processing stays on the device.

One-pixel compression joke

Tap the About logo seven times: a built-in sample picture gets comically compressed until one large pixel remains. The offline surprise processes no personal image and changes no real output or settings.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Ads, purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Ads and optional ad removal

All described functions are planned to be free, with banner ads and optional one-time Google Play ad removal. No subscription is planned. The purchase screen shows the actual local price; purchase restoration uses Google Play.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
